Per chunk checks: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; L9 'The product owner brings.../The designer brings.../The team lead brings...' anaphora triple but each leg carries new concrete content; L9 'Three memories, one bet, three seats.' is a noun list closing a verbed paragraph; L81 'not the version Claude landed alone' single contrast, not a stacked tic; no superlatives (grep 'most useful|best|powerful' -> 0); no number+retraction; no verb triplets.
